verdict.rationale: Natural language is Exa's core interface. Search takes natural-language queries (exa-docs-22, exa-docs-36), and Websets start from a natural-language query plus criteria, buildable no-code in the dashboard (exa-docs-28, exa-docs-8, exa-docs-29). The hosted MCP server and its `agent_run` tool also let users drive search, research, list-building and enrichment by talking to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor (exa-docs-40, exa-docs-50, exa-docs-30). Hands-on reports show natural-language Websets queries do run, but with poor match precision: one user estimated about 30/70 on target, another got one match and 14 misses (exa-comm-1, exa-comm-4). That is a reliability concern, not a contradiction of the capability. missing for 10: evidence that account, key and billing management can be done in natural language; independent corroboration that natural-language queries reliably return what was asked.
